title: Jingle Bells · Piano nỉ
heard: v1 on a phone: "hơi nhỏ và rè" (a little quiet and buzzing); "thêm tiếng chuông thỉnh thoảng điểm vào để bớt nhàm chán" (bells dotted in now and then, less monotonous); for atmosphere the user chose a soft bed of strings.
about: v2: the tune an octave up in the last verse; a soft bed of strings (their highs cut over 4-4.5 kHz, where their recordings hiss); the glockenspiel doubling the chorus (its first phrase in the first verse, all of it in the last) and answering the long notes, 2 dB softer than its role; sleigh bells shaken twice in the last chorus; the piano's lows eased for a phone's speaker (under 300 Hz 5 dB less, above 1.5 kHz 3 dB more); the glockenspiel's and the piano's sharpest attacks held down (rendered first without, the piece had to stay at -17 LUFS rather than be limited more than 3 dB).
